name: Sea Sweepers (TSA Video Game Design)
author: anushap6571
description: Updated- "Sea Sweepers" is a challenging yet meaningful game dedicated to represent the vast, bottomless, depths of the ocean and the trash we polluted it with. Draw "trampoline-like" surfaces for the ball to bounce from and collect starfish in order to protect them from pollutants. Capture buckets of mysterious liquid to free the ocean of the waste that gets dumped. This also allows you to refill your drawing pen. But watch out because some objects make you run out of ink quickly!
